SPORTS WEEK · SB p. 104 📖

Three texts — three sports! 📖

🎯 Ex. 1 — pairs: what sport uses these? A skis · B goggles · C the bat! Then ex. 2 — match the texts to the photos.
1 · Jill 🏓 → photo C (table tennis) 2 · Rod ⛷ → photo A (skis — skiing in Argentina) 3 · Alistair 🏊 → photo B (the goggles — swimming)

🗣 We say: — Jill plays table tennis at school. Rod always goes skiing in August.

Exam Spot · SB p. 104 🐯

The tiger riddle! 🐯

🎯 Ex. 4 — complete the text (the box, two extra words!). «What am I? I am a tiger.»
② eyes (e) ③ legs (h) ④ vegetables (f) ⑤ the sun (b) ⑥ swimming (d)
🚫 The extra words: c man · g teeth (the text already says teeth!)
Exam Spot · SB p. 104 ✍️

My favourite sport — write! ✍️

🎯 Ex. 5 — write 40–50 words. The questions help you:

1 What's your favourite sport? · 2 When do you do it? · 3 Where do you do it? · 4 Who do you do it with? · 5 Are you a champion?

🗣 My favourite sport is… · I do/go/play… at/on/with… · I'm / I'm not a champion and/but… · I always/sometimes/never win.

🎬 Lights, camera, action!
Exam Spot · SB p. 105 🎧

Listen — summer camp photos! 🎧

🎯 Ex. 6 — listen and match names 1–4 to pictures a–f. Two extra pictures!
1 · Beatrice ✔️ → e (tennis — the example) 2 · Charlie 🐕 → b (he's with Bobbie — the dog!) 3 · Mel 🎂 → f (Mel's birthday party) 4 · Jeff 🐍 → d (at the zoo — Jeff's got a snake)
Communication · SB p. 105 🎫

② Can ___? Can I have three tickets, please? ③ Where's ___? Where's the concert? ④ Can ___? Can I buy CDs at the concert? ⑤ What time ___? What time is the concert?
